parsed.name: NI-DAQmx 系统管理组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件系统管理组件，用于表示和管理 NI-DAQmx 数据采集系统。它用于访问本地或远程 DAQmx 系统、枚举设备与已保存任务/通道/标度，并执行与硬件配置相关的系统级操作，如端子路由、上电默认状态设置以及 cDAQ 同步连接配置。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software system management component that represents and manages an NI-DAQmx data acquisition system. It is used to access local or remote DAQmx systems, enumerate devices and persisted tasks/channels/scales, and perform system-level hardware configuration operations such as terminal routing, power-up state configuration, and cDAQ synchronization setup.
